title: haplopappus inuloides var. howellii
intro: Haplopappus inuloides var. howellii, commonly known as Howell's goldenrod, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Howell's goldenrod include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Haplopappus inuloides var. howellii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
